# Myrmic WASM Host Interface — Authoritative Definition

**Interface name:** `myrmic-wasm-host`
**Version:** identical to the Official Release version this file ships with (see `EXCEPTION-SCOPE.md`)
**Source of truth:** the `extern "C"` import declarations in the `myrmic-sdk` crate of the same Official Release. This file is generated from those declarations and lists every host function a WebAssembly Cell may import from the Myrmic runtime, grouped by import namespace.

An Application interacts with Covered Code through this interface when its WebAssembly module imports only functions listed here, from the namespaces listed here. Availability of individual namespaces may differ between targets (for example, `gateway` is provided by operating-system hosts only).

| Namespace | Functions | Imported functions |
|---|---|---|
| `arguments` | 1 | `get_arguments` |
| `ble` | 9 | `ble_connect`, `ble_disconnect`, `ble_read`, `ble_scan`, `ble_set_pair_passkey`, `ble_stop_scan`, `ble_subscribe`, `ble_unsubscribe`, `ble_write` |
| `cell` | 7 | `cancel_timer`, `create_timer`, `publish_event`, `send_command`, `spawn_cell_host`, `stop_self_host`, `terminate_cell_host` |
| `db` | 21 | `blob_link`, `blob_move`, `blob_resolve`, `blob_store`, `blob_unlink`, `find_measurement`, `key_delete`, `key_get`, `key_prefix`, `key_put`, `path_resolve`, `paths_list`, `publish_measurement`, `sem_select`, `sem_update`, `tb_append`, `tb_count`, `tb_delete`, `tb_get`, `tb_insert`, `tb_list` |
| `error` | 1 | `report_error` |
| `gateway` | 2 | `gateway_mount`, `gateway_unmount` |

| `time` | 3 | `now_host`, `uptime_host`, `wait_host` |
